svg.title: Blue Green Red
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Actual ordinary Met 544×600 public preview inspected in the browser. Green rectangular field; broad blue horizontal curved lens in upper half touches both sides; red band across bottom roughly23.6percent. Thin black external frame omitted. Museum disables enlargement/download; no enlarged or alternate hidden file requested. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red, green, blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/489307; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
